name: Gravija
doc: Gravija (Diablos' enemy attack): the master and the main task - the grey screen flash, the layout at the targets' average point, the screen warp around every target, the particles, the sound; the action results. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag311_gravija.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the magic buffer, its warp mesh copy in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Main
parts.doc: The grey screen flash, the layout at the targets' average point, the screen warp around every target, the particles, the sound; the action results

params.label: Main
params.doc: The prim-model layout main (its models' animation)

params.label: Particle
params.doc: The sprite sequence particle (a flipbook of 50 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Model 101B0E8
params.doc: The prim model at 0x101B0E8 (a mesh of 241 vertices, 240 primitives: its code copies it whole into a block of its size: an edited one keeps its vertices and its size (move vertices, change colours and texture corners))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
